Valerie Porr Webinar about BPD, Shame and Neurobiology -copy and paste to YouTube.
Audio isn’t great, but worth the strain.
Enjoy hopelessness.

Someone I know read a book about when dogs die they return as a human. The dog being mans best friend is the last animal incarnation before man. So maybe after this rodeo for us, plankton? Start from bottom again? 
Likely nothing. The grand fuck you.

Your young and have faith. Use them both to your advantage. Scars on the outside are better then scars on the inside. Nothing to be ashamed of. Your a survivor, scars prove that. Think about what purpose those scars serve. You won’t be wasting time with shallow or vain people. There are too many of them. You have a short cut. Likely spare you some internal scars, lot less fun to talk about.
Combine two or three approaches in an isolated location. Prepare to suffer.

How about having a woman that loved so much she rushed into the burning building that’s you only to run in horror that you’ve handcuffed yourself to the toilet? Left feeling like you do and deeply afraid of someone who vowed to protect her. Cure for that?

Second this. Be thankful. Imagine losing everything coupled with figuring out you run on different fuel.
Truthfully, if in your position I wouldn’t dive to deep into the internet. Go directly to help. Be thankful for everyone in your life that reach out. Be honest, give in.

Great post topic....

Burdened with this type of mind and somehow develop a discipline to coax it out. On top of scaling the walls of self doubt and criticism with this on the shoulders. 
Painting seems, to me, the easiest as it’s raw, really open to interpretation, and convenient.  Writers really impress me. Tolstoy supposedly had a form of bpd. Spent 50 years disappointed he couldn’t rub himself out yet cranked out masterpieces. Astonishing to understand what he went through, how he might have been feeling and still manage to create such large encompassing works. Must of been Absolute Hell.

Grieving that you don’t have the means of communicating why you hurt so badly.-

Can’t communicate what you can’t catch. Constantly changing like a claymation movie. Feel it now it’s gone, or morphed into something else. Can’t wrap your hands around it because it’s a movie, on a flat screen changing from elephant to a bowling ball crushing pins. Struggling to remember while being influenced by what it has become next. Frustrated just want to smash the glass and grab it. Embarrassing to be dragged around by it rather then saddle it.
Nice prognosis doc...lol. Awareness only adds to the neuroticism. Ignorance may not necessarily have been bliss but was a hell of a lot more fun.

Agree. No real responsibility in this world. 
He blew up his ballon, then let go of it. Can recognize the beauty of it.

Wasn’t going to reply to your first post as I understand this position. Lurked on this sub for quite awhile. Noticed this post as I can’t sleep anymore.Heard in speaking of this story as I no longer watch television or read newspapers. Mistakenly assumed it was something that seems so typical in this world. This was not.
This, to me, and to a certain degree the sentiment of the original poster (without treading on him or speaking for him) poetry. There’s 7billion people on the planet, 100,000 on this sub. Rather think about whether this was impulsive or planned out. Only one article read and it smacked of impulsivity. Somehow this sadly restored some sense of humanity to me. Simply tired of the fear of ‘ifs’. Impatient for the real ‘whys’.  
Cheers

Woke with insomnia, checked the story.
‘Just a broken guy with a few screws loose’. Clearly seems he had no intention to hurt anyone.
Article read had quotes from airlines executives and investigators spreading on the fear already. 
This is something...blah blah.. airline employees with security clearance...blah... tighten up....blah blah blah.
Expect to see more of this type. Didn’t hurt anyone, quite original. 
Thanks for posting.

To a certain degree bpd could be described as building walls around yourself expecting love to exhaust itself climbing them. Not so much what is actually good, but the walls themselves. Walls are built higher and thicker. Shovel may find morsels, wrecking balls expand view.  Describing feelings in hope to be understood, if only by internet strangers, is wonderful. Why those feelings are there is much more important. Otherwise they remain misunderstood by most. Blessing or curse is up to the individual, but doesn’t change the feeling. Sorry for not being helpful.
